A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
re-engagement in the care is a dynamic process and that the factors associated with re-attendance are not static.
the cumulative incidence rates of return to care were high, especially among people who started ART with higher CD4 counts.
the re-engagement in follow-up care is a complex process and is not just a matter of distance to care.
The main takeaway from our work is that

re-engagement in ART care can be improved by better monitoring of patients and their CD4 counts, and by providing more support to patients who have a lower CD4 count and are far away from their clinic.
